notes.title: Scarab Tales bugs show their love
notes.content:
We still care! Game builds were checked and updated under latest operating systems (Windows 10, Mac OS X Sierra, ...). Enjoy your puzzles. :-)

And if you like multiplayer space RPG shooters, we have just launched our Space Merchants: Arena game. Come check it out! :-)
http://store.steampowered.com/app/548080

notes.title: Performance update
notes.content:
Dear players, we have optimized Scarab Tales to run more smoothly and with significantly lower CPU and GPU usage. We have also fixed a few bugs (typos in achievements' names, missing sound for fireworks effect etc.).

We are already thinking about next update, which should implement some improvement tips we've received from the community. Stay tuned! :-)

notes.title: Possible buy problem
notes.content:
Dear players, due to possible technical issue in Steam store you might not be able to buy our game at the moment. We hope it will be resolved during today.

In the meantime you can support us in the campaign below and be informed when the buying starts fully working (click on "support with"):
https://www.thunderclap.it/projects/28312-scarab-tales-on-steam-july-1

Thank you very much for your patience and support!
